card.name: Words just before a possible 'over'
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word endings (for, from, will, of, contains, the S in PATIENTS) where the next word could be 'over' or 'overdose'. Seen in all-caps warning text and in plain prose about long spans or sources.

modes.label: Linking word before 'over'
modes.description: A preposition or verb in running prose where 'over' could come next, such as 'for over' a period of time.
modes.example: the central figure in the civilized world<< for>> nearly two thousand years

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: Words inside capitalized caution or warning statements about patients and doses.
modes.example: CAUTION SHOULD BE EXERCISED WHEN ADMINISTERING PROMETHAZINE HYDROCHLORIDE TO PEDIATRIC PATIENT<<S>> 2 YEARS OF AGE AND OLDER

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'over' (and forms like -over) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small words where the next word might well be 'over', as in 'for over two years'.
